store_app_companyManagement_longDesc:
Company Management is the official Oxlyn app to manage every aspect of your business in Los Santos.

Manage employees (hire, fire, assign roles and salaries), control finances with deposits and withdrawals, keep your inventory organized, and customize everything in Settings.

Also includes automatic income and expense reports for the last 7 days, hierarchical org chart view, and a communication center for team announcements.
store_app_companyManagement_whatsNew:
Version 2.4.1
• New pyramid org chart for ranks
• Per-employee bonus system
• Team announcements
• Company fleet
store_app_browser_longDesc:
Fast, simple, and secure browser.

Search the Los Santos intranet, read the news, and stay up to date. Supports multiple tabs, dark mode, and pre-configured favorite sites.
store_app_browser_whatsNew:
Version 17.4
• Startup speed improvements
• Security fixes
store_app_calculator_longDesc: The classic calculator for everyday basic calculations. Supports arithmetic operations, percentages, and keyboard shortcuts.
store_app_calendar_longDesc: View the current month, navigate between dates, and stay organized. Perfect for tracking appointments and important events.
store_app_clock_longDesc: World clock, stopwatch, and timer in one place. Ideal for tracking time zones or timing activities.
store_app_clock_whatsNew:
Version 4.0
• New design
• Stopwatch with laps
store_app_settings_longDesc: The central panel of your system. Customize wallpaper, sound, language, and much more.
store_app_notes_longDesc:
Take quick notes with auto-save, pin your favorite notes to the top, and search through your entire history.

Supports a free-form text editor, folder organization (coming soon), and sync across your system devices.
store_app_notes_whatsNew:
Version 1.0
• Initial release
• Editor with auto-save
• Pinned notes
• Instant search
store_app_reminders_longDesc:
To-do lists with dates, priorities, and multiple customizable lists.

Create lists for different areas of your life (Personal, Work, Shopping), set due dates, and mark priorities. Overdue tasks are highlighted in red.
store_app_reminders_whatsNew:
Version 1.0
• Initial release
• Smart lists (Today, Scheduled, Priority)
• Customizable lists with colors and icons
• Priority system

notes_welcome_body:
Welcome to the Notes app!

Use this app to save thoughts, reminders or any important information.

Shortcuts:
• "+" button at the top creates a new note
• Search in the field at the top
• Right-click a note to open menu (pin / delete)
• Notes save automatically as you type

You can delete this note at any time.
